What happens to my Amazon & Kindle library when I die?

Short answer: Amazon only shares account details or takes most actions for the authorised estate representative. If the account is closed, all purchased digital content goes with it, including Kindle books and notes, Audible, Prime Video and Amazon Music purchases, and Amazon Photos. Download photos and invoices before any closure request is made.

Key facts

  • Only the estate representative can act fully
  • Closure removes Kindle, Audible, Prime Video and Music purchases
  • Gift card balances are lost on closure
  • Contact: bereavement-support-cs@amazon.com

How do I prepare my Amazon & Kindle library account?

  1. List your Amazon account email in your digital estate plan.
  2. Download Amazon Photos and key invoices periodically.
  3. After a death, the executor emails Amazon's bereavement team with the documents below.
  4. Without full authorisation, Amazon can still cancel subscriptions, stop recurring deliveries and deactivate the account with a death certificate.

Read the official policy ↗

What documents do heirs need?

  • Death certificate
  • Proof you're the estate's legal representative (such as probate or executor documents)
  • Valid photo ID
  • The account's email or phone number, or an order number to locate it

How long does it take?

Amazon verifies the documents, then acts; no fixed timeframe is published. Documents are deleted after validation.

What can't be recovered?

  • Kindle books, notes and highlights, Audible and other digital purchases, once the account is closed
  • Amazon Photos content not downloaded beforehand
  • Gift card balances
  • Order history and invoices

Frequently asked questions

What happens to my Amazon & Kindle library when I die?

Amazon only shares account details or takes most actions for the authorised estate representative. If the account is closed, all purchased digital content goes with it, including Kindle books and notes, Audible, Prime Video and Amazon Music purchases, and Amazon Photos. Download photos and invoices before any closure request is made.

Can I inherit someone's Kindle books?

Amazon's help pages describe no way to transfer purchased digital content, and closing the account removes it. Keep the account and its devices in mind before requesting closure.

What can family do without probate?

With a death certificate, Amazon can terminate subscriptions, stop recurring deliveries and deactivate the account.

Does closing Amazon close Audible too?

Yes. Amazon lists Audible, Prime Video, Amazon Music, Amazon Photos and Kindle among the services lost on closure.
